items.title: Rules Generator: phantom "(unknown)" rules that don't exist in Vortex's own current data
items.why: Director confirmed live, directly in Vortex's own 'Manage rules' dialog: for both real repro mods (Praedy's College of Winterhold 2K, Exist's Caves PBR - 2K), Vortex itself shows only ONE real rule -- but this app's own report shows a SECOND phantom "(unknown)" rule Vortex doesn't have at all. This isn't a missing-detail problem, it's reading a rule that may no longer be real/current.
items.prompt:
REAL BUG, director's own live investigation directly in Vortex (screenshots): for TWO separate real repro mods -- "Praedy's College of Winterhold 2K" and "Exist's Caves PBR - 2k" -- Vortex's own real 'Manage rules' dialog shows only ONE real, current rule (e.g. "after Faultier's PBR Landscapes 2k"). But this app's own 'Current rules for X' report shows TWO: the real one, PLUS a phantom "after (unknown)" rule that doesn't exist in Vortex's current data at all.

This changes the original framing of this task (it started as 'show detail for the unresolved rule' -- that's now confirmed wrong; the real issue is this app is surfacing a rule that may not be real/current at all, not just failing to name a real one).

INVESTIGATE LIVE, root cause -- don't guess: read the real state.v2 rules data for one of these two exact repro mods directly (same read path this app's own rule-generator code uses -- `lib/rules-generator.js`'s `getOldModRuleSet`/`resolveRefToModKey`) and compare it against what Vortex's own UI currently shows. Real candidate causes to check, not assume which:
  (a) a genuinely STALE/orphaned rule entry still sitting in Vortex's raw state.v2 data, pointing at a mod that was since removed/uninstalled -- Vortex's own UI might silently filter these out of its 'Manage rules' display while this app's own raw read doesn't.
  (b) a real parsing/matching bug in THIS app's own code that's fabricating or duplicating a rule entry that was never real to begin with.
  (c) a rule referencing a DIFFERENT mod entirely that Vortex's UI groups/displays differently than this app expects (e.g. a rule on a related/hidden companion mod, not literally 'this exact mod' the way Vortex's dialog title implies).

FIX, per the director's own explicit fallback direction if root cause can't be cleanly resolved: **if a rule's target genuinely cannot be resolved to anything real, don't surface it as a countable/actionable item at all** -- not as 'couldn't be matched,' not as '(unknown)' -- just silently exclude it from `rulesToConsider`/the summary count entirely. This is a real behavior change from the original task's own direction (which asked to surface MORE detail for these) -- the new, corrected instruction is the opposite: if it's genuinely not real/current, drop it silently rather than showing it at all. Only keep surfacing a rule as 'couldn't be matched' if it's a REAL, current rule (confirmed to exist in Vortex's own data) whose target just doesn't have a counterpart in the new collection -- that's a genuinely different, still-real case worth keeping visible.

VERIFY LIVE against both real repro mods (Praedy's College of Winterhold 2K, Exist's Caves PBR - 2k) -- confirm the report's own rule count/detail now matches what Vortex's own 'Manage rules' dialog genuinely shows for each, no phantom '(unknown)' entries. If you find a real, still-current rule elsewhere that genuinely can't be matched to the new collection, confirm THAT case still shows correctly (not silently dropped -- only the phantom/stale case should be). Handoff with the real root cause you found for the phantom entries.
